title: Decision tree depth
statement: Let $\Omega$ be finite, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree with alphabet $\Omega$ and labels $\alpha$. Its depth is $0$ for a leaf; at a query, its depth is one plus the maximum depth among the child trees indexed by answers in $\Omega$.
